retrievalProfile.description: A 1980s airbrushed sci-fi aesthetic featuring a vertical geometric spacecraft ascending from a planetary horizon into a starfield with high-contrast chrome and neon typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A vertical, brightly colored catamaran-style spacecraft with sharp fins and a red-to-purple gradient hull, positioned centrally over a curved blue and green planetary horizon against a black starfield. The scene is framed by stylized, italicized chrome lettering with speed lines on the left and stacked neon-bordered block text on the right.
coreVisualRelationships: Curved planetary horizon providing a base for the vertical ascent
Symmetrical typography flanking the central vessel
High-contrast transition from dark space to bright atmospheric glow
coreInvariants: Airbrushed texture with soft glows and sharp highlights
Vibrant red-to-purple gradient on the primary vehicle
Italicized chrome lettering with horizontal speed-line extensions

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, vertical spacecraft dominates the center, extending from the bottom third to the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white engine exhaust at the bottom center of the craft.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Upward vertical movement from the planet surface, following the craft's trajectory, then outward to the flanking text elements.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black starfield in the upper two-thirds provides high contrast for the subject and text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and navy blue for the space background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright cyan and emerald green for the planetary surface.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vivid red, orange, and magenta for the spacecraft and neon text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the subject and text against a low-value, dark background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif with extreme italics and blocky structures.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a heavy italic slant with horizontal 'speed lines' extending from the left of the characters.
Secondary text uses a stacked, blocky, modular construction with neon outlines.
Sharp, 45-degree angles on terminals and corners.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'S' and 'E' characters feature elongated horizontal bars that merge into background speed lines.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between sleek, horizontal chrome speed-type and chunky, vertical neon block-type.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the base geometric structure for the primary text.
Captures the retro-tech feel of the secondary block text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed 80s space scene with a curved blue/green planet at the bottom and a black starfield above. Center a vertical, red-to-purple gradient catamaran-style spaceship with white engine glow.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom beveled chrome lettering with horizontal speed lines in the top left and stacked neon-outlined block text in the top right.

verificationChecks: Is the spacecraft vertical and centered?
Does the primary text have horizontal speed lines?
Is the planetary horizon curved and textured with green/blue?
Are there star glints on the metallic surfaces?

postGenerationChecks: Check for airbrushed grain texture across the image.
Ensure the chrome text has a visible bevel and gradient.
Verify the engine exhaust has a soft, diffused glow.
Confirm the spacecraft has a distinct catamaran (twin-hull) silhouette.
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Airbrush Space + [Subject: Geometric Vehicle] + [Environment: Planet Horizon/Starfield] + [Typography: Chrome Speed-Type]
